description: This file defines a lexer for parsing conditions in event handling within the vtiger CRM system. It contains token definitions, DFA configuration for token recognition, and error handling tailored for parsing conditional expressions in the context of VTEvent conditions.
external_methods: learned on the context of similar lexer files

classes.name: VTEventConditionParserLexer_DFA9
classes.description: A DFA class used internally by the lexer for recognizing specific token patterns defined by the lexer rules for condition parsing, specifically for tokens like operators, identifiers, string literals, and whitespace.

methods.name: reportError
methods.description: Handles parsing errors by raising an exception when an invalid condition is encountered.

methods.name: mINTEGER
methods.description: Matches sequences of digits representing integer literals.

methods.name: mSTRING
methods.description: Matches string literals enclosed in single quotes.

methods.name: mSYMBOL
methods.description: Matches symbol tokens, which can be variable names or identifiers, including support for backtick-enclosed names.

methods.name: mELEMENT_ID
methods.description: Matches element identifiers that start with digits followed by 'x' and digits (e.g., '1205').

methods.name: mLETTER
methods.description: Matches alphabetic characters for identifier components.

methods.name: mWHITESPACE
methods.description: Matches whitespace characters (space, tab, line breaks) and hides them from token stream.

methods.name: mTokens
methods.description: Primary token recognition method that dispatches token matching based on DFA prediction.
